sentences.text: While the present proceedings were pending, samples of the goods were drawn and were sent for testing.

This was informed to this court on 22.07.2024 and this court had passed the following order:
"1.

Mr. Singla, learned counsel appearing for the respondent, has drawn our attention to a communication dated 12 July 2024 addressed to the authorized officer of the National Food Laboratory, Food Safety & Standards Authority of India and in terms of which a request has been made to the said authority to designate an officer who may draw samples as per the request of the petitioner which has come to be accepted.

entities.text: National Food Laboratory, Food Safety & Standards Authority of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: It is presently not known as to whether further steps have now been taken in that regard.

2. Bearing in mind the fact that the consignment had been detained in February,
2024, we request the respondents to proceed further with due expedition.

3. Let this writ petition be called again to review progress on 12.08.2024."
4.
Thereafter, at a hearing held on 25.09.2024, this Court was informed that the goods had been examined by Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI).

In the aforesaid circumstances,
this Court had directed the concerned authority to examine the report and pass an appropriate order.
